A test asserts resources.iter_resources is not called for such a pick. A call-count test shows budget.preflight and ledger.runs called zero times inside pick on that path. (3) A recorded measurement of 10 in-process cached_only picks against live state, run from the main checkout's environment with this worktree on PYTHONPATH and the same inputs dispatch passes, gives a median of 2,000 ms or less and a maximum of 5,000 ms or less, with the Jev call's own latency shown separately. It sits in a log under this run's directory, beside the base-revision median for the same 10 picks, which is about 15,000 ms today. (4) The gate is tests/test_picker_latency.py, tests/test_picker_in_dispatch.py, every other tests/test_picker*.py file, tests/test_routing_surface.py and the dispatch tests that import the changed call site (find them by grep under tests/), run at base and head with zero added failure ids.
